title: Map: First British Overflight, 6 December 1959 (U-2 route over the USSR)
description: Map titled "First British Overflight, 6 December 1959" showing the southern USSR, Middle East and South Asia. A route line runs north from Peshawar, Pakistan, to Kuybyshev, then southwest past Saratov Engels Airfield and Kapustin Yar across the Caspian region to Adana, Turkey. Labeled features include Moscow, Tyuratam, the Kazakh, Uzbek, Turkmen, Kirgiz and Tadzhik S.S.R.s, and scale bars in kilometers and miles; marked Secret NOFORN.
